semantics: Base equipment economics only. Country/MIO modifiers, designer variants and eligibility are separate; the source snapshot remains unverified against the target patch.

rule_sources.rule: Ordinary equipment inherits general attributes via archetype; parent denotes its predecessor.
Duplicate archetypes/types after their source; for_each excludes the archetype. Alias/type/variant names are not copied.
Upgrade resource thresholds declare total added cost, not cumulative costs.
